headline: The International Stock Exchange of Moldova has been launched in Chișinău. Its strategic partner is the Bucharest Stock Exchange
summary: The International Stock Exchange of Moldova (BIMx) was officially launched in Chișinău with Prime Minister Vasile Tofan present. The Bucharest Stock Exchange is its strategic partner.
why: A new national stock exchange can broaden capital-raising options and attract listings, which matters for investors looking at frontier and emerging European markets.

original_headline: A fost lansată, la Chişinău, Bursa Internaţională a Moldovei. Are ca partener strategic Bursa de Valori Bucureşti
